description:
Ha Do-gyeong signs up for a Paris travel package where you can be matched with your desired partner.
As a dom, he expects to be paired with someone submissive to his taste—but instead, he ends up meeting a man who is obviously an S at first glance. Realizing they share the same dynamic, the two part ways without hesitation. After sightseeing alone in Paris, Do-gyeong returns to his hotel, only to run into his former partner right at the door. The man, Shin Kang-woo, apologizes for earlier and suggests they have a drink together. But Do-gyeong suddenly feels a strange shift—while Kang-woo was clearly a dom before, now he seems more like a sub...
Just who is Kang-woo, really?!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/o0o/), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000055594), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9339384)

**Official Translations:**

*The T.Chinese translation is uncensored.*
